title: Za'atar roast vegetables with whipped feta

source.title: Meera Sodha's recipe for za'atar roast vegetables with whipped feta

instructions: Heat the oven to 220C/200C fan/gas 7 and line two large baking trays. Cut the courgettes into rough 3cm pieces, the onion into 1½cm wedges and the aubergine into rough 5cm × 4cm pieces.
In a bowl, toss the courgettes and onion with a third of the feta broken into small pieces, 3 tbsp oil, 1 tsp za'atar and ½ tsp salt. Spread out on one tray.
In the same bowl, toss the aubergine with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp za'atar and ¼ tsp salt. Spread on the second tray and keep the bowl. Roast both trays for 30 minutes, until tender and golden in spots.
Meanwhile, blitz the remaining 200g feta with the yoghurt, 3 tbsp oil, the lemon zest, ½ tbsp lemon juice and ¼ tsp salt until smooth. Spread over a large platter.

Tip the roast vegetables and their juices back into the bowl, stir through the butter beans and torn mint, season with black pepper, oil and salt to taste, and pile on top of the whipped feta. Finish with a pinch of za'atar.
